restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday search: 2^96 groups with shared m0..m14; each group enumerates all 2^32 values of m15.
Digests computed by partial evaluation of the 2-round compression (shared group-invariant G work), not by charging one full compression unit per message.
Collision filter: Briggs-Torczon sparse set keyed by the top 140 digest bits; matches re-verified with two full reference compressions.
Classical 256-bit word RAM with 64 registers. Claimed ledger uses register-resident group constants; a reload-all fallback bound of 127.583 is disclosed.
Success probability 0.39 under score-critical H1-grouped-digests; time/memory caps are worst-case and heuristic-free.
Analytical construction; no full-scale collision certificate.
Independent derivation of m15 amortization; public awaiting-review notes near 127.481 were research pointers only and were re-counted (honest inner body 260 Word ops).
Cancel+replace candidate vs awaiting-review 18ad754c (128.11 multi-trail VOW): ~0.59 bits lower with a different algorithm. Memory ~2^146 is reported only (unscored).

heuristics.statement: For uniform independent group prefixes (m0..m14) and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for the purpose of bounding (i) the probability of no full-digest collision among them and (ii) the probability that a colliding pair is missed because an earlier distinct digest occupied the same top-140-bit sparse-set slot, up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3933) and the claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Applies only to this grouped birthday search with N=2^128 messages, sparse-set index of 140 bits, and the stated partial-evaluation digest map. Does not assert differential weakness, rho statistics, or sub-birthday structure.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer-scaled experiments use truncated digest masks with N_t^2/2^w matched to N^2/2^256. Agreement of collision-detection frequencies with the random model at 20-bit masks is extrapolated across the remaining digest bits. Truncation cannot rule out global algebraic dependence induced by fixing 15 message words.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is not proved. Within-group messages share structure; only a 2^-96 fraction of pairs are within-group. Masked experiments cannot detect full-size anomalies. Memory footprint is huge. No full-scale run exists.
